messages:
Carmen: Quick sync — I uploaded a first-pass asset pack for the three cloud offers. Need eyes on: hero imagery sizing, region routing, and trial entitlement labels. (AWS/GCP/Azure differences)
Raj: Checking now. Do we have AMI IDs or marketplace image refs yet?
Marta: Not for Azure. For AWS we have a placeholder AMI (ami-0abc1234). Need final from infra.
Carmen: @Marta can you flag the final AMI and GCP image path by EOD? We can't submit without them.
Marta: Yep — pinging infra lead in a sec.
Noah: UX note — marketplace trial blurbs must match the trial duration in billing. If product says 14-day trial, listing copy must be identical.
Evelyn: Legal: confirm the trial messaging and the promotional T&Cs PDF. We need localized EULA snippet for EU. Also, ensure the support SLAs on the listing match the contract (SaaS Basic vs SaaS Enterprise).
Carmen: Evelyn — I'll attach the draft T&Cs here. Please call out any redlines.
Evelyn: Will do. Quick note: Azure requires a separate privacy checklist for EU data residency claims.
Raj: For routing — we need a mapping table: region -> preferred marketplace (e.g., eu-west -> EU marketplace instance vs global). This impacts our telemetry endpoints and allowed SKUs.
Carmen: Proposed routing table in the manifest below. Thoughts?
Carmen: ```
offer_id: redwood-inference
regions:
  - name: us-west-2
    marketplace: aws
    sku_prefix: RW-AWS
  - name: europe-west1
    marketplace: gcp
    sku_prefix: RW-GCP
  - name: westeurope
    marketplace: azure
    sku_prefix: RW-AZ
```
Raj: That's a good start. For billing we also add meter_id per SKU. I'll stub those in.
Noah: On packaging — can we provide a single launch tile graphic and then marketplace-specific cropped versions? That'll speed approvals.
Marta: I can produce 3 crops (16:9 for AWS, 1:1 for Azure, 4:3 for GCP). Uploading to the shared drive now.
MarketplaceBot: Deployment checklist created: checklist/3587654321-visibility-and-assets. Assignments: Marta (images), Raj (SKUs/metering), Evelyn (legal), Noah (copy).
Carmen: Great. Action items: Marta finalize images + AMI/GCP image ref; Raj finalize SKU/meter IDs; Evelyn finalize T&Cs localization; Noah sign off on copy. Target: internal review by tomorrow 1500 PT. :calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Evelyn: I'll prioritize EU localization first. Expect comments in the doc by 12:00 PT.
Raj: I'll add meter IDs and ping finance for SKU naming constraints.
Marta: AMI note — infra says AMI will be ready 6pm PT. If that's late we can submit with a placeholder and request short approval window.
Noah: Fine with placeholder if it's clearly marked as temporary. Add "PLACEHOLDER" suffix to any temp SKUs.
Carmen: Thanks team. If anyone finds blockers, drop them here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
